description:
ORB Rotation Benchmark
	

This repository contains the dataset for “Seeing Straight: Document Orientation Detection for Efficient OCR” (arXiv:2511.04161).
ORB Rotation Benchmark is a structured multi-domain dataset designed to evaluate document orientation detection models and their impact on downstream OCR performance.
Unlike prior document datasets that assume correct orientation, this benchmark explicitly introduces controlled rotation settings (4-class, 8-class, and 12-class… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/krutrim-ai-labs/ocr_rotation_bench.
reputation: Emerging, specialized benchmark for document orientation detection with growing adoption in OCR and document-understanding research.
